meta.description: Word highlight start times (seconds from the start of the shipped Luna mix) for playSong88. One entry per .kw index (kw0..kwN).
meta.kw_rule: karaokeHTML assigns id=kw{i} in order of parseSong words: each whitespace token of the first songs.json 'lines' lines of music-data.js (all nine Luna songs use the full lyric). Pipes mark syllables only and are stripped from the displayed word.
meta.method: Mix placement from mix.py (2-beat intro, line wav starts at intro+0.15 with 0.4s take lead-in, then melody-JSON note durations at the mix BPM). The first word of each line is the first clear sung onset of that line's dry vocal take (a rise from silence at the 0.4s lead-in unless the singer is clearly early or late). Later words follow the score, shifted by that line onset, and snap to a nearby dry-vocal energy rise only when the rise is clearly better than the score. Whisper (faster-whisper small.en, lyric prompt on each dry take) was a cross-check and was dropped when it ran early of the sung onset, which it often did.
meta.note_for_builder: Times are relative to file start (t=0 of the decoded buffer). playSing starts the buffer at audioContext.currentTime+0.08; schedule highlights on the audio clock (t0 + LUNA_T[s.id][i]) rather than from the click.
